news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS (IB-Stim) therapy, adding over 500,000 covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic region. This extends the company's push toward comprehensive nationwide reimbursement following the January 2026 CPT Category I code activation.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will report Q2 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026) financial results before market open on August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call at 9:00am ET to discuss results and provide a business update.

news.headline: NeurAxis, Inc. Declares Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board declared a Q2 2026 stock dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock, payable in roughly 80,463 shares of common stock (paid July 29 to holders of record July 21), conserving cash while modestly diluting common holders.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis reports summarized Q2 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026) financial results before market open, with a call at 9:00am ET; watch for whether the Q1 2026 revenue acceleration (+80% YoY) driven by the new PENFS CPT Category I code continued into Q2.

catalysts.label: Further payer/medical-policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim
catalysts.detail: Company has been announcing incremental regional insurer coverage wins roughly monthly (April and August 2026 so far) as it works toward comprehensive nationwide reimbursement policy coverage; additional insurer announcements are a recurring near-term catalyst but no specific dates are confirmed.

catalysts.label: VA (Veterans Affairs) commercial ramp
catalysts.detail: Following its Federal Supply Schedule contract award (effective Dec 2025) and VA commercial launch (Jan 2026), continued adoption progress within the VA hospital system (nearly 7 million veterans) is an ongoing catalyst, though no specific milestone dates are confirmed.

pulse: NeurAxis continues to execute a reimbursement-driven growth strategy for its IB-Stim/PENFS pediatric neuromodulation device, with Q1 2026 revenue up 80% YoY on the strength of the new CPT Category I code and expanding payer coverage, and an early-August Mid-Atlantic coverage win adding another 500,000+ covered lives. Q2 2026 results land August 11, 2026, and will be the key near-term signal on whether the coverage-driven revenue acceleration held through the June quarter. The company remains a small-cap, cash-constrained story funding itself partly via share-based Series B preferred dividends while it works toward nationwide reimbursement and VA system adoption.
